description: cut_in_component_returns (jobs/transport.rs ~2182) asks whether the callee is in the owner's cycle group, under the derivation whose waits are Direct edges (closure-call returns skipped) or All edges; the non-rising function id tie-break is unchanged. Deletes ReachKey (Direct, All) and the Reach product entirely. On even/odd the cut must stay on odd->even. Predict: dumps identical.
title: The transport cut asks the engine for the owner's cycle group
